<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 262.09938. This matches the monoisotopic mass of a neutral molecule C₁₈H₁₄O₂ (262.09938 Da). The isotopic pattern (≈20 % M+1) is consistent with ~18 carbons, supporting this formula. Therefore the molecular formula of the sample is C₁₈H₁₄O₂.</thought>
<final_answer>C18H14O2</final_answer>
